title: Your privacy at Xcard
message: Please read our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. We process account details, messages and transaction information to provide the service. Optional camera and microphone access is requested when you use those features. Android photos and videos are selected through the system picker. Tap Agree and continue to use Xcard.

second.title: Privacy agreement required
second.message: Please review our Privacy Policy before continuing. If you disagree, you can exit Xcard.
